page_title: BRE 4-3 IPS | Brentford v Ipswich 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Liam Delap (Ipswich) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!

90+6' 4 - 3 What a beautiful moment! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Arijanet Muric just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 4:3.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Conor Townsend (Ipswich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jens Cajuste walks off.
86' 3 - 3 Liam Delap (Ipswich) meets a perfect cross from Leif Davis deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:3.
85' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
83' Cameron Burgess (Ipswich) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies well wide of the left post.
81' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) replacing Keane Lewis-Potter.
78' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' It will be a substitution. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Christian Norgaard walks off.
77' Substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard is replaced by Kevin Schade (Brentford).
75' Ipswich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' Substitution. George Hirst did his best and is replaced by Liam Delap (Ipswich).
73' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Sammie Szmodics is replaced by Jack Clarke (Ipswich).
73' Here comes a substitution. Conor Chaplin is given a rest as he is replaced by Luke Woolfenden (Ipswich).
72' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
70' Lewis Smith blows his whistle and Harrison Clarke (Ipswich) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
69' Wes Burns (Ipswich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
66' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
65' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
62' The current number of shots on goal is 5:4.
58' A pass by Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
53' A terrific attempt by Wes Burns (Ipswich) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
52' 3 - 2 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Arijanet Muric into the roof of the net.
51' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is going to take the penalty!
51' The Brentford players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

50' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Brentford.
49' Harrison Clarke (Ipswich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Lewis Smith had an easy-decision to make.
48' The corner is swung in but Ipswich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+9' Lewis Smith blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.
45+3' Wait! Referee Lewis Smith has indicated he is going to review the Brentford goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

45+1' 2 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Harrison Clarke (Ipswich), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the middle of his own goal and behind the goalkeeper.
45+1' It's a goal! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) beats the keeper and increases his team's tally.
45+1' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' 1 - 2 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
43' What was Leif Davis (Ipswich) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

41' Leif Davis (Ipswich) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
40' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
39' A rebound falls kindly for Leif Davis (Ipswich), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!

38' George Hirst (Ipswich) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Mark Flekken pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
38' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' Chiedozie Ogbene has picked up an injury and is replaced by Wes Burns (Ipswich).
34' Chiedozie Ogbene (Ipswich) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' 0 - 2 George Hirst (Ipswich) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes inside the left post.
29' 0 - 1 Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
27' Harrison Clarke (Ipswich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
25' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is able to continue to play.
23' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ipswich comes to nothing.
19' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
16' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
16' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
13' Neat passing move from Brentford in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
8' Great teamplay by Ipswich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Ipswich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
4' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
3' Ipswich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lewis Smith is the one to supervise the game today.
